selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subject is indeed a Pongo pygmaeus and not a different ape species or hybrid artifact.
To verify structural integrity of the visible head, neck, and shoulder connection points, ensuring no fusion artifacts exist where the head meets the body.
To analyze the fine-grained details of the fur for signs of AI 'smearing', repetitive patterns, or unnatural glossiness common in generated hair.
To check the edge definition between the complex facial hair/skin and the background foliage for any bleeding or haloing artifacts.

Facial symmetry and skin pore detail on the nose/muzzle
